title: EPOCH: Coverage-Aware Evolution with Experiential Preference Optimization for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.17379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) discovers heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs), where an LLM generates candidates in an evolutionary search. Existing frameworks freeze the generator or fine-tune it on a scalar fitness signal hiding which instances each heuristic covers. Reflection-based frameworks improve heuristics with natural-language feedback, but it stays in the prompt and never reaches the generator's weights. We propose EPOCH, which makes instance coverage the objective of the evolutionary search and fine-tunes the generator to internalize reflection. Parent selection, operator allocation, and stagnation recovery all optimize how well the heuristics jointly cover the training instances, so the search returns a complementary heuristic ensemble. The generator learns from its own search by experiential preference optimization. A teacher LLM returns a natural-language insight on the generated heuristics

translated_title: EPOCH：面向基于大语言模型自动启发式设计的覆盖感知进化与经验偏好优化
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动启发式设计（AHD）旨在为组合优化问题（COP）发现启发式方法，其中LLM在进化搜索中生成候选启发式。现有框架要么冻结生成器，要么仅基于标量适应度信号对其进行微调，而这种标量信号掩盖了每个启发式所覆盖的具体实例。基于反思的框架虽然利用自然语言反馈改进启发式，但这些反馈仅停留在提示词层面，从未作用于生成器的权重。我们提出EPOCH，它将实例覆盖率作为进化搜索的目标，并微调生成器使其内化反思能力。父代选择、算子分配和停滞恢复均以启发式联合覆盖训练实例的程度为优化目标，从而使搜索返回一个互补的启发式集合。生成器通过经验偏好优化从自身的搜索过程中学习，教师LLM则对生成的启发式给出自然语言洞察（摘要原文在此处中断）。
tldr: EPOCH将实例覆盖率作为进化搜索的优化目标，并通过经验偏好优化让LLM生成器内化反思、从自身搜索经验中学习，从而为组合优化问题自动进化出互补的启发式集合。
en_tdlr: EPOCH makes instance coverage the objective of evolutionary search and fine-tunes the LLM generator via experiential preference optimization to internalize reflection, automatically evolving complementary heuristic ensembles for combinatorial optimization problems.
